item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] Lankan envoy in Bangladesh meets Dhaka Chamber of Commerce and Industry
item.description: The High Commissioner of Sri Lanka to Bangladesh, Dharmapala Weerakkody, met with the Dhaka Chamber of Commerce and Industry (DCCI) President Taskeen Ahmed, on 18 October 2026 at the DCCI office in Gulshan, Dhaka, to explore avenues for strengthening economic, trade and investment cooperation between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh.

item.title: [Daily FT - Business/Sectors] Alumex wins Bronze at National AI Awards 2026 for AI-powered manufacturing innovation
item.description: Alumex PLC, a member of the Hayleys Group and a leading manufacturer of aluminium extrusions in Sri Lanka, has won a Bronze award in the ‘Best AI Solution in Manufacturing and Industry 5.0’ category at the National AI Awards 2026 on 30 September. The award was bestowed under the auspices of the Digital Economy Ministry.
